answer: Delta-ladder bond: each identity files one claim in the nebula registry and posts a 70-credit bond. Claims are priced on a rising ladder: the first rung costs 40, the k-th rung 40+6(k-1), each rung stamped in umber ink, its price public. A second claim under one key, or a rented rung with the lender's sable seal, burns the bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 3,037,000 and locks 70,000, chasing a 40,000 prize pool. One honest agent pays 40 once.
